title: Fare search with gradual flag rollout
name: Fare ranker rollout

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code assigns users to a percentage rollout? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
After startup, the flag source becomes unreachable and every poll fails. What does IsEnabled return for a flag that existed in the last successful load?
choices: The defaultValue passed by the caller, because the store is considered invalid
The result computed from the last successfully loaded snapshot
False, because refresh failures reset the snapshot to empty
It blocks until the next successful refresh

questions.prompt: Many request goroutines call IsEnabled while the poll goroutine refreshes. Why is no mutex needed?
choices: Go maps are safe for concurrent reads and writes
The poll goroutine only runs when no requests are in flight
Each snapshot is built completely and never modified, and readers see it through an atomic pointer swap
IsEnabled copies the whole map before reading it

questions.prompt: A flag has Enabled=false, RolloutPct=100, and the caller's user ID is in AllowList. What does IsEnabled return?
choices: True, because the allow list is checked first
The caller's defaultValue, because the flag is contradictory
False, because the Enabled check comes before the allow list and rollout
